public_source.name: TraceLab
public_source.attribution: TraceLab, SyFI Lab, University of Washington
public_source.timing_semantics: Synthetic observable latency categories from reported WebFetch and WebSearch internal execution durations, keeping original execute outputs and tokens.

semantics: Synthetic observable latency classes; original execute outputs and tokens retained.

source_work.scope: Causal event/request graph and native usage only. Native service is an unresolved request operation, not its original elapsed time. Exact token execution, native EOS, session equivalence and GPU performance require separate qualification.

cpu_dependency_evidence.scope: Complete CPU DAG consistency with zero model-service fixtures. These times are not GPU performance, migration opportunity or application JCT predictions.
